functions.name: reject_document_revision_mutation
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.reject_document_revision_mutation()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'document revisions are immutable' USING ERRCODE = '55000';
END;
$function$
